title: PlanExecuteRequest
description: The body of `POST /v1/plans/{planId}/execute` (06 §5): which variants to run, and the context audio the client rendered and uploaded for every generate step. The plan itself is stored server-side from `POST /v1/plans`, so the client never posts it back. `contexts` is keyed by the generate step's `id`; a `generate.extend` step needs `context`, `generate.inpaint` and `generate.transition` need `before` and `after` (09 §2.1).

variants.description: Indexes into the stored plan's `variants` (0-based). Omitted means every variant that has a generate step.

ExecuteVariantIndex.description: 0-based index into the plan's `variants`; the plan's own length is the upper bound, so an out-of-range index is a 400 that names it.

ExecuteContextMap.description: Rendered context assets per generate step id.

ExecuteContext.description: The assets one generate step was rendered with. Only the keys its capability declares are accepted.

before.description: The outgoing side of a two-sided capability (inputs.assets.before).

after.description: The incoming side of a two-sided capability (inputs.assets.after).
